title: `meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts` TEACHING_SITES is a hand-maintained two-file list, but a third site teaches the route today (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`)
body:
Spin-off from #13859 (PR #14557), reported by the dev as a **possible** third instance of the "corpus grew, the gate's population did not" shape that #13859 and #13678 name — and a weaker one that may be correct as written. Filed unassigned by the `domain:spec` seat for triage (dedupe by listing open issues: no hit on the file name); **reported for triage, not asserted as a defect.**

## The observation

`packages/rest/src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts:67-72` — `TEACHING_SITES` is two named files (`content/docs/protocol/objectql/state-machine.mdx` and `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`) asserted to CONTAIN the canonical route. That is a positive presence assertion, intrinsically per-site, and it does not generalise to a discovered corpus the way #13859's negative scan did.

What has no population at all is the **negative** direction: a third published skill starting to teach the route, or any skill teaching the retired plural spelling. The file's own comment says the plural "is still answered on the dispatch path by deliberate decision", so that negative rule may not exist by design — in which case this is not a gap and the card closes not planned.

## Ask for triage

Decide whether a negative scan over `skills/**` for the retired plural spelling is wanted (then it is a sibling of #13859, one test file, `packages/rest` = `domain:cli` by the lane table) or whether the deliberate-decision comment settles it (then close not planned with that reason).
